name: 25. DeepSeek Anthropic-Compatible Migration
description:
DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (/anthropic/v1/messages, x-api-key auth) is opt-in: ResolveUseAnthropicEndpoints (core/providers/anthropic/utils.go) reads the resolved alias config, then key.use_anthropic_endpoints, and falls back to the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions wire when neither is set. The shared harness DeepSeek key deliberately leaves the flag unset so the ~240 other deepseek rows keep pinning the OpenAI-compatible path; this folder targets the deepseek-v4-flash-anthropic alias declared on that key in tests/integrations/python/config.json, which carries use_anthropic_endpoints: true (#7610).

Every row asserts the OUTBOUND payload via extra_fields.raw_request, not just the response: the Anthropic wire carries max_tokens and content-block arrays, the OpenAI-compatible wire carries max_completion_tokens and plain strings. Before #7610 the rows only asserted on the response, which is identical on both wires, so they passed for months without ever reaching /anthropic/v1/messages.

Cases: (1) chat completions non-streaming and (2) streaming (raw_request is attached to the final SSE frame), (3) two independent tools requested in one turn come back as two tool_calls, (4) native /v1/responses (no chat-completion fallback). All four cases send reasoning.effort none, which reaches the wire as thinking.type disabled (each row asserts it): DeepSeek's Anthropic endpoint thinks by default and thinking tokens count toward max_tokens, so a reasoning-on turn at a small budget returns stop_reason length with a reasoning item and no message item.

exec: pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible chat completions: 2xx', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.below(400);
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible chat completions: content non-empty', function () {
var msg = j.choices[0].message;
pm.expect(msg.content, 'empty content: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;
// #7610: the assertions above pass on either DeepSeek wire. Only the outbound payload proves
// the alias-carried use_anthropic_endpoints routed this call through /anthropic/v1/messages:
// Anthropic takes max_tokens + content blocks, the OpenAI-compatible wire takes
// max_completion_tokens + a plain string.
var rr = (j.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null).slice(0, 400);
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible chat completions: outbound wire is Anthropic-shaped (#7610)', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - send_back_raw_request not honored: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.max_tokens, 'max_tokens absent - request went out on the OpenAI-compatible wire: ' + wire).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(rr.max_completion_tokens, 'max_completion_tokens present - request went out on the OpenAI-compatible wire: ' + wire).to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(rr.messages, 'messages missing on the wire: ' + wire).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(rr.messages[0].content, 'user content is a plain string - OpenAI-compatible wire: ' + wire).to.be.an('array');
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible chat completions: reasoning.effort none reached the wire as thinking disabled (#7610)', function () {
pm.expect(rr && rr.thinking && rr.thinking.type, 'thinking not disabled on the wire - a reasoning-on turn spends max_tokens on reasoning before any content or tool call: ' + wire).to.eql('disabled');
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible streaming: 2xx', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.below(400);
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
var content = '';
var finished = false;
var lastRawRequest;
pm.response.text().split('\n').forEach(function (line) {
if (line.indexOf('data:') !== 0) { return; }
var payload = line.slice(5).trim();
if (!payload || payload === '[DONE]') { return; }
var chunk;
try { chunk = JSON.parse(payload); } catch (e) { return; }
if (chunk.extra_fields && chunk.extra_fields.raw_request) { lastRawRequest = chunk.extra_fields.raw_request; }
var choice = chunk.choices && chunk.choices[0];
if (!choice) { return; }
if (choice.finish_reason) { finished = true; }
if (choice.delta && choice.delta.content) { content += choice.delta.content; }
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible streaming: stream reached finish_reason', function () {
pm.expect(finished, 'no finish_reason in stream: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.true;
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible streaming: content accumulated', function () {
pm.expect(content.length, 'no content in any delta: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.above(0);
// #7610: the assertions above pass on either DeepSeek wire. Only the outbound payload proves
// the alias-carried use_anthropic_endpoints routed this call through /anthropic/v1/messages:
// Anthropic takes max_tokens + content blocks, the OpenAI-compatible wire takes
// max_completion_tokens + a plain string.
var rr = lastRawRequest;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null).slice(0, 400);
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible streaming: outbound wire is Anthropic-shaped (#7610)', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - send_back_raw_request not honored: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.max_tokens, 'max_tokens absent - request went out on the OpenAI-compatible wire: ' + wire).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(rr.max_completion_tokens, 'max_completion_tokens present - request went out on the OpenAI-compatible wire: ' + wire).to.be.undefined;
pm.expect(rr.messages, 'messages missing on the wire: ' + wire).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(rr.messages[0].content, 'user content is a plain string - OpenAI-compatible wire: ' + wire).to.be.an('array');
pm.test('deepseek anthropic-compatible streaming: reasoning.effort none reached the wire as thinking disabled (#7610)', function () {
pm.expect(rr && rr.thinking && rr.thinking.type, 'thinking not disabled on the wire - a reasoning-on turn spends max_tokens on reasoning before any content or tool call: ' + wire).to.eql('disabled');
